adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` returns the full Zod `safeParse` result object (`{ success, data, error }`), not the parsed `data`. In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff changes `const key = googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials);` to `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then persists `key` directly via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. This would store the SafeParseReturn wrapper in the DB instead of the credential payload, matching the finding.
